apiToken.description: A Dagster+ API token. May also be set via the `DAGSTER_CLOUD_API_TOKEN` environment variable. Generate a token at Dagster+ → Account Settings → API Tokens.

baseUrl.description: Override the base URL for the Dagster+ API. Defaults to `https://{organization}.dagster.cloud`. Only needed for on-prem or custom deployments.

organization.description: The Dagster+ organization name (e.g. `my-org` for `my-org.dagster.cloud`). May also be set via the `DAGSTER_CLOUD_ORGANIZATION` environment variable.

allAssets.description: When true, the policy applies to all assets. Mutually exclusive with asset*selection and asset*key.

assetKey.description: A specific asset key path (e.g. `myAsset` or `group/my_asset`). Mutually exclusive with all*assets and asset*selection.

assetSelection.description: An asset selection string (e.g. `tag:my-tag`). Mutually exclusive with all*assets and asset*key.

healthStatus.description: Trigger on a health status transition: degraded, warning, or healthy. Mutually exclusive with specific_events.

specificEvents.description: Trigger on specific asset events. Mutually exclusive with health*status. Valid values — materializations: materialization*success, materialization*failure; asset checks: check*passed, check*warn, check*error, check*execution*failed; freshness: freshness*passing, freshness*warning, freshness_failure.
